module_catalog.name: Academic information management 111
module_catalog.content: Find, evaluate, process, manage and present information resources for academic purposes using appropriate technology.
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Engineering, Built Environment and Information Technology Faculty of Education Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences Faculty of Humanities Faculty of Law Faculty of Health Sciences Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences Faculty of Theology and Religion

module_catalog.name: Academic information management 121
module_catalog.content: Apply effective search strategies in different technological environments. Demonstrate the ethical and fair use of information resources. Integrate 21st-century communications into the management of academic information.
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Engineering, Built Environment and Information Technology Faculty of Education Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences Faculty of Humanities Faculty of Law Faculty of Health Sciences Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences Faculty of Theology and Religion Faculty of Veterinary Science

module_catalog.name: Anatomy 111
module_catalog.content: Anatomy for communication pathology This module is on the theory and practical experience of the structure of the organs involved with speech production and hearing excluding neuro-anatomy. Anatomical terminology and elementary study of tissues; gross anatomy of structures involved with speech production and hearing: larynx, skeletal components and muscles involved with respiration, viscera of the respiratory system, bones and paranasal sinuses of the skull, synopsis of the cranial nerves, structure of the viscera of the vocal tract, structure of the ear; embryology of the face, palate, tongue, larynx and ear.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week, 1 practical per week

module_catalog.name: Foundations of audiovestibular sciences 110
module_catalog.content: Closed – requires departmental selection Introduction to the physics and psychoacoustics of sound. Basic anatomy, physiology, pathology and aetiology of the peripheral and central auditory and vestibular systems.

module_catalog.name: Typical language development  111
module_catalog.content: Typical language development across the lifespan, from prenatal language learning to infancy, the toddler years, preschool and school-age language and literacy development, and adolescent and adult language use. Factors influencing language development.

module_catalog.name: Fundamentals of hearing assessment and intervention 120
module_catalog.content: Fundamental principles and techniques involved in standard audiometric assessment. Introduction to hearing devices and aural rehabilitation.
module_catalog.contact_time: 4  lectures per week S2 only Q4

module_catalog.name: Basic audiovestibular testing: Practicum 181
module_catalog.content: Clinical knowledge and exposure to audiovestibular screening and assessment.

module_catalog.name: Physiology 110
module_catalog.content: Introduction (terminology and anatomical orientation); chemical principles; cytology and histology; neuro-physiology and the senses; haematology and body fluids; cardiovascular system.
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Humanities Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences

module_catalog.name: Physiology 120
module_catalog.content: Respiratory system; nutrition; digestion and metabolism; kidneys and acid-base equilibrium; endocrinology; reproduction physiology and reproduction; skin and body temperatures.
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Humanities Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences

module_catalog.name: Integrated healthcare leadership 120
module_catalog.content: Leadership and multidisciplinary teamwork. Healthcare systems and legislation. Determinants of health. Introduction to healthcare models (e.g. community-based care, family-centred care, etc.). Professionalism, Ethical principles. Management of diversity.

module_catalog.name: People and their environment 112
module_catalog.content: This module comprises basic psychology and sociology concepts relevant to medicine, and to dentistry, in the case of BChD students. Basic psychiatric concepts are also taught.
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Health Sciences Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences

module_catalog.name: Sepedi for beginners 119
module_catalog.content: *For absolute beginners only. * Students from the School of Healthcare Sciences and the School of Dentistry, who already possess the language skills taught in this module, may write an exemption examination. The acquisition of basic Sepedi communicative skills with emphasis on everyday expressions and suitable high frequency vocabulary, within specific social situations.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week, 1 discussion class per week

module_catalog.name: Communication processes and introduction to linguistics 110
module_catalog.content: Overview of linguistics, exploring the nature of language, speech, and communication.  Application of theory to linguistic concepts including pragmatics, semantics, syntax, morphology, and phonology. Overview of normal receptive and expressive language processes.

module_catalog.name: Fundamentals in phonetics 182
module_catalog.content: Introduction to articulatory phonetics. The speech communication process – production phase. The speech organs: position and function. Different airstream mechanisms, consonant table, articulatory and perceptual characteristics of consonants.

module_catalog.name: Setswana for beginners 110
module_catalog.content: * For absolute beginners only. The acquisition of basic Setswana communicative skills with emphasis on everyday expressions and suitable high frequency vocabulary within specific social situations.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week, 1 discussion class per week

module_catalog.name: isiZulu for beginners 119
module_catalog.content: *For absolute beginners only * Students from the School of Healthcare Sciences, who already possess the language skills taught in this module, may write an exemption examination. The acquisition of basic isiZulu communicative skills with emphasis on everyday expressions and suitable high frequency vocabulary, within specific situations.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week, 1 discussion class per week

module_catalog.name: Differential audiological assessment 210
module_catalog.content: Behavioural and objective differential diagnostic audiological assessment. Electro-acoustic equipment and calibration.
module_catalog.contact_time: 4 lectures per week S1 only Q1

module_catalog.name: Aural rehabilitation across the lifespan 211
module_catalog.content: Aural rehabilitation for infants, children and adults with hearing loss: assessment, intervention components, counselling, services and the shared role of the speech-language therapist and audiologist.

module_catalog.name: Fundamentals of audiological intervention 220
module_catalog.content: Aetiology and pathology of the auditory and vestibular system. Cerumen management. Invasive and non-invasive hearing devices.
module_catalog.contact_time: 4  lectures per week S2 only Q4

module_catalog.name: Auditory processing, vestibular and perceptual disorders 221
module_catalog.content: Introduction to auditory processing and vestibular disorders. Assessment and management of tinnitus and sound intolerance.
module_catalog.contact_time: 4  lectures per week S2 only Q4

module_catalog.name: Audiovestibular screening, assessment and intervention: Practicum 281
module_catalog.content: Clinical knowledge and skill development in audiovestibular screening, assessment and intervention.

module_catalog.name: Integrated healthcare leadership 210
module_catalog.content: This module aims to enhance integrated healthcare leadership through interprofessional teamwork in the context of community health. The focus is especially on communication skills, project development and health promotion. The theory is applied in a health education needs/strength analysis.
module_catalog.prerequisites: IHL 120 (For Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology, Physiotherapy and Dietetics students only IHL 120 is applicable).
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week, 4 practicals per week

module_catalog.name: Neuro-anatomy for communication pathology 211
module_catalog.content: This module focuses on the theory and practical experience of the structure of the central nervous system, course and distribution of the cranial nerves and embryology of the central nervous system. Division; embryology of the central nervous system; histology of the nervous system; gross anatomy: spinal cord, brain stem, cerebral hemispheres, ventricles, meninges and circulation of cerebro-spinal fluid, blood circulation, cranial nerves, autonomic nervous system and tracts of the CNS.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1 lecture per week, 1 practical per week

module_catalog.name: Neuro-physiology 221
module_catalog.content: Neuronal physiology, central nervous system, peripheral nervous system, including the afferent and efferent divisions.

module_catalog.name: Advanced clinical audiology 310
module_catalog.content: Electrophysiological and vestibular assessment and rehabilitation. Assessment and management of auditory processing disorders.
module_catalog.contact_time: 4 lectures per week S1 only Q1

module_catalog.name: Paediatric audiology 320
module_catalog.content: Paediatric audiology: Identification, diagnosis and intervention. Educational audiology.
module_catalog.contact_time: 4 lectures per week S1 only Q1

module_catalog.name: Preventative audiology 321
module_catalog.content: Identification, monitoring, and managing risks to auditory damage, including ototoxicity, excessive noise exposure and chemical exposure.
module_catalog.contact_time: 4 lectures per week S1 only Q1

module_catalog.name: Advanced clinical audiology: Practicum 381
module_catalog.content: Clinical knowledge, exposure and skill development in diagnostic audiovestibular assessment and intervention in private and secondary healthcare settings.

module_catalog.name: Community-based and preventative audiology: Practicum 382
module_catalog.content: Clinical knowledge, exposure, and skill development in community-based and preventative audiology.

module_catalog.name: Integrated healthcare leadership 310
module_catalog.content: Community needs assessment. Leadership in community development. Planning and implementation of collaborative community-based interventions. Application of principles of monitoring and evaluation. NB: Only for School of Healthcare Sciences and Department of Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology students.

module_catalog.name: Research methodology for healthcare sciences 300
module_catalog.content: Concepts of research; research process; research studies appraisal; planning and developing literature review; developing research idea and research question; research principles in designing research proposal; research proposal writing.
module_catalog.prerequisites:
AIM 111, AIM 121, ELH 121, ELH 122, 
BA Audiology: ODL 210, ODL 220 and KMP 210, KMP 220 
BA Speech-Language Pathology: SPP 210, SPP 220 and KMP 210, KMP 220.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week, 2 discussion classes per week
